strapiBlog.title: Ras Al Khaimah Unveils New Luxury Island Destination - Raha Island
strapiBlog.short_description: Ras Al Khaimah has recently unveiled a new island destination, taking advantage of the current real estate boom in the emirate.

data.text:
Ras Al Khaimah has recently unveiled a new island destination, taking advantage of the current real estate boom in the emirate. RAK Properties, the master developer, is leading the 'Raha Island' project, which is located in Mina Al Arab. Here are some insights about the luxury destination that have been revealed so far.

The Raha Island Project

The Al-Raha Island is set to become a premier address for luxury island living within Ras Al Khaimah, featuring over 2.5 kilometers of accessible public beaches. It will boast a mix of high-end hotels and branded residences, catering to discerning buyers seeking an exclusive lifestyle.

Edge on Raha Island, Mina Al Arab is an exciting new development in the area, featuring studios, 1 & 2-bedroom apartments, and penthouses. This premier project offers a variety of elegant units, each designed to provide residents with stunning lagoon views and yacht-inspired balconies.

"We are confident that Raha Island will meet the current demand for upscale, meticulously designed developments," stated CEO Sameh Al Muhtadi. "Our goal is not only to fulfil this demand but to surpass expectations by enhancing this prestigious destination."

Mina Al Arab, a waterfront district in Ras Al Khaimah, is renowned for its pristine beaches, lush landscaping, and protected coastal wetlands. It offers a tranquil escape from urban life with convenient access to five-star hotels, resorts, and shopping venues. Popular sub-communities within Mina Al Arab include Granada, Malibu, Lagoon Views, Flamingo Villas, Lagoon Marina, Lagoon Walk, and Bermuda.

Luxury Real Estate Boom in Ras Al Khaimah

Ras Al Khaimah has been experiencing a remarkable surge in luxury real estate development, underscoring its growing appeal as a prime destination for high-end living. Over the past year, numerous prestigious projects in Ras Al Khaimah have been launched, including Emaar's Address Residences and Aldar's Nikki Beach project, enhancing the emirate's reputation for upscale residential and hospitality offerings.

The ongoing development of several high-profile hotel projects, such as the flagship Wynn resort on Al Marjan Island, highlights the significant investments pouring into the region. With the first of these major projects expected to open within the next three years, the timing of RAK Properties' launch of Raha Island is impeccable. This new addition further cements Ras Al Khaimah's status as a hotspot for luxury real estate, attracting both investors and discerning buyers seeking exclusive and meticulously designed developments.

faqs.question: How big is Mina Al Arab?

data.answer: Mina Al Arab, developed by RAK Properties, spans an area of approximately 43 million square feet. This waterfront community in Ras Al Khaimah features a mix of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, including luxury homes, hotels, retail outlets, and extensive green areas, as well as beaches and lagoons.

Ras Al Khaimah offers a blend of natural beauty and cultural experiences, including the stunning Jebel Jais mountain with its famous zipline, the historic Dhayah Fort, and the serene Al Hamra Village and Al Marjan Island. Visitors can explore the Al Wadi Nature Reserve, relax on the pristine beaches of Mina Al Arab, and enjoy luxury at The Cove Rotana Resort. The emirate also features the bustling Al Hamra Mall and the unique Ras Al Khaimah National Museum, providing a mix of adventure, relaxation, and cultural discovery.
